title: Consolidated activity export with smart facets and streaming pagination
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Implement a single, auditable export surface on the Console that supports multi-facet filtering, streaming pagination (cursor/tokens), and large-scale CSV/JSON downloads while respecting RBAC v2 redaction rules and SSO-derived identity mappings. The export UI should let users build and save queries, preview first 1,000 rows, and either stream results to browser or hand off to a backend job for very large exports. Key goals: ensure exports are auditable (who exported what when), minimize memory/CPU pressure on serving runtime, and make permission checks consistent with backend APIs and Private/VPC deployments.

Scope: Console viewer/search/export only (frontend + API orchestration + export worker). This ticket covers design, API contract, backend streaming worker, and role-aware redaction integration. It does NOT include long-term retention policy changes or a data lake ingestion pipeline (these are follow-ups).

Design constraints and non-goals:
- Exports must enforce RBAC v2 in the gateway layer; sensitive fields should be redacted server-side, not client-side.
- For Dedicated/Private deployments, export endpoint must be able to operate without egress by writing to customer-configured S3/MinIO (follow-up).
- Avoid building a separate ad-hoc query language; we will reuse the existing console filter DSL and canonicalize it for the export service.

Trade-offs discussed:
- Streaming CSV from the API keeps memory costs low but complicates retries; background job with chunked files is easier to retry but introduces latency for users. We will support both: small exports stream; large exports are offloaded to background worker with an object URL.
- Redaction at query time is simpler for performance but may leak schema differences; strict server-side redaction chosen for security at minor CPU cost.
acceptance_criteria: Users can apply multi-select facets and free-text search and preview results up to 1,000 rows in the Console viewer
Exports honor RBAC v2 rules and redact fields for which the requesting principal lacks permission
Streaming endpoint supports cursor-based pagination tokens and can resume after transient failures
Large exports (>100k rows) automatically create a background job and provide an export artifact URL (CSV or ndjson)
All export actions are recorded in the audit trail with user identity (SSO-mapped), filter parameters, and resulting artifact URL or error
Saved queries persist per-org and honor share settings; saved query metadata is included in export audit event
